title: Store accepted indicator artifacts independently of chart presentation
context: A profile can preview different computations over one frozen chart and compare them with an accepted output. Layout v9 stores panel configuration and a separate source preference. A later correction, removal, cache loss or restart must leave the accepted artifact attributable to its original input.
decision: Add indicator version, layer state and layer operation tables in SQLite v10 on layout checkpoint 5eebdb9. Persist the exact source and computation snapshots, warm-up boundary, resolved parameters, artifact and hashes in the immutable version. Put mutable layer attachments in a separate table. Commit a human-approved version, its attachment and the shared operation receipt and retry identity in one writer transaction.
authority: M3-001 and the indicator lifecycle in the engineering contract require reproducible previews and immutable acceptance. ADR 0007 delegates versioned local persistence and verification.

alternatives.option: Keep only a recipe and recompute on restart.
alternatives.reason: This cannot restore the exact accepted bytes after an input correction, engine change, withdrawal or trusted Python interaction with external state.

alternatives.option: Embed accepted values in the layout or the operation log.
alternatives.reason: Each accepted version has its own source entitlement and retention lifecycle. Presentation and audit records need only the layer and version references.

consequences: A failed v10 migration rolls back without changing layout v9 data or its ledger. A failed acceptance rolls back the version, attachment, receipt and workspace revision together.
The registry binds confirmation to the delivered preview and exact inputs. A committed retry recovers the original receipt, and removal and undo change the attachment without changing version bytes.

Restoration reads validated artifact bytes under current source rights. A revoked source leaves an unavailable version reference. Restoring a version never starts computation or reuses an execution approval.
This delivery uses profile-local published CSV and declarative evaluation. User-selected trusted Python requires a separate per-run approval and verification under ADR 0002.
revisit_when: Another adapter supplies retention terms, accepted outputs exceed the inline result envelope, or an explicit version deletion path needs a retention and recovery policy.
